changelog: Native Package Installer Support: include Android system package installer in APK chooser alongside third-party installers.
Partial Text Quoting: support quoting highlighted text in Formatted select mode without overriding clipboard.
Clickable File Paths: inline code file paths in chat messages now open files directly on tap.
Crash Diagnostics & Crash Buddy: interactive crash screen with event breadcrumbs and diagnostics.
Submodule Cleanup: removed unused heavy submodules and cleaned up home screen widget overhead.
